programs.title: Don't Open the Door
programs.desc: A man dressed as Santa guns down an L.A. family on Christmas Eve and burns their house to the ground; when a coroner's report connects the massacre to a bizarre crime scene across town, the scope of killer's plan is revealed.

programs.desc: Dani discovers a new world with Tash, but risks it for a once-in-a-lifetime surf break; Buddy and Shirley get caught up in Mac's dangerous dealings in Bali; a tragedy changes Buddy's life forever.
